import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int P;
    static int modPow(int base, int exp) {
        int res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (int)((long)res * base % P);
            base = (int)((long)base * base % P);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int L = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        P = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        int MAX_N = 250005;
        int MAX_M = 1 << 17;
        int MAX_D = 18;
        
        int[] fac = new int[MAX_N];
        int[] ifac = new int[MAX_N];
        int[] popcount = new int[MAX_N];
        
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= L; ++i) {
            fac[i] = (int)((long)fac[i - 1] * i % P);
            popcount[i] = popcount[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
        }
        
        long total = modPow(K, L);
        if ((L & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(total);
            return;
        }
        
        ifac[L] = modPow(fac[L], P - 2);
        for (int i = L; i >= 1; --i) {
            ifac[i - 1] = (int)((long)ifac[i] * i % P);
        }
        
        int[] bits = new int[20];
        int n = 0;
        for (int i = 1; (1 << i) <= L; ++i) {
            if ((L >> i & 1) == 1) {
                bits[n++] = 1 << i;
            }
        }
        
        int m = 1 << n;
        long[][] suma = new long[MAX_D][MAX_M];
        long[][] sumc = new long[MAX_D][MAX_M];
        long[][] dp = new long[MAX_D][MAX_M];
        long[][] tmp = new long[MAX_D][MAX_M];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            int s = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if ((i >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    s += bits[j];
                }
            }
            suma[popcount[i]][i] = ifac[s];
        }
        
        for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
            long[] a = suma[t];
            for (int len = m; len >= 2; len >>= 1) {
                for (int j = 0, step = len >> 1; j < m; j += len) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < step; ++k) {
                        a[j + k + step] += a[j + k];
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                a[j] %= P;
            }
        }
        
        for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
            System.arraycopy(suma[t], 0, dp[t], 0, m);
        }
        
        int revK = 0, cnt = 0;
        for (int temp = K; temp > 0; temp >>= 1) {
            revK = (revK << 1) | (temp & 1);
            ++cnt;
        }
        --cnt;
        revK >>= 1;
        
        for (; cnt > 0; --cnt, revK >>= 1) {
            for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
                Arrays.fill(tmp[t], 0);
            }
            
            for (int a = 0; a <= n; ++a) {
                for (int b = 0; a + b <= n; ++b) {
                    long[] f = tmp[a + b];
                    long[] g = dp[a];
                    long[] h = dp[b];
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                        f[j] += g[j] * h[j];
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                    dp[t][j] = tmp[t][j] % P;
                }
            }
            
            if ((revK & 1) == 1) {
                for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
                    Arrays.fill(tmp[t], 0);
                }
                
                for (int a = 0; a <= n; ++a) {
                    for (int b = 0; a + b <= n; ++b) {
                        long[] f = tmp[a + b];
                        long[] g = dp[a];
                        long[] h = suma[b];
                        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                            f[j] += g[j] * h[j];
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                        dp[t][j] = tmp[t][j] % P;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
            System.arraycopy(dp[t], 0, sumc[t], 0, m);
        }
        
        for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
            long[] a = sumc[t];
            for (int len = 2; len <= m; len <<= 1) {
                for (int j = 0, step = len >> 1; j < m; j += len) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < step; ++k) {
                        a[j + k + step] -= a[j + k];
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                a[j] = (a[j] % P + P) % P;
            }
        }
        
        long ans = (total - sumc[n][(1 << n) - 1] * fac[L] % P + P) % P;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
